content.title: HPE Analyst Day To Focus On AI Growth Outlook, Juniper Deal Impact
content.summary: When Hewlett Packard Enterprise hosts an investor day on Wednesday, Wall Street analysts will be looking for its long-term outlook in the wake of its acquisition of Juniper Networks as well as updates on its artificial intelligence strategy.  HPE stock hit an all-time high last week amid raised expectations.  "We expect long-term revenue growth targets to increase mid to high single digits given Juniper combination and continued demand observed across the segments while its AI business continues to perform with backlog of $3.7 billion," said Citi analyst Asiya Merchant in a report.

content.title: Hewlett Packard Enterprise, Robert Half, Rumble, QuinStreet, and Ziff Davis Stocks Trade Down, What You Need To Know
content.summary: A number of stocks fell in the afternoon session after worries over worsening trade relations with China were triggered by critical comments from President Donald Trump. Trump targeted China's tightening controls on rare earth metals, which are vital components in many technology products from electric vehicles to defense systems. The president's tone and the suggestion of canceling a meeting with President Xi caused a rapid sell-off in the market.
